why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: Check that you can use it. You must be at least 18. The terms bar people from countries under US sanctions, among them Russia, Belarus, Iran, Cuba, North Korea, Syria and Venezuela, and they ban VPNs and multiple accounts.
Open catalyst.app and press Join waitlist. Enter your email address. The X handle is optional.
Wait for the invite code by email, then create your account with it. We didn't join, so we haven't seen this part ourselves.
Fund the wallet only if you decide to trade. The FAQ lists Apple Pay, credit cards and "crypto assets like USDC, SOL, ETH, and BNB" for deposits. Withdrawals are in stablecoins for now.
